title: Extended Level 5 Diploma in IT Management
description: Develop integrated expertise in information technology, business management, programming, databases, leadership, and organisational decision-making.
longDescription: This Extended Level 5 Diploma in IT Management provides learners with a multidisciplinary foundation in information technology, business administration, management, and organisational leadership. The programme combines IT-focused learning with programming, database management, economics, mathematics, and business management to develop well-rounded technology management capabilities. Learners explore Python programming, introductory programming, database management systems, calculus, linear algebra, and ICT alongside management and organisational principles. The programme also develops leadership, communication, interpersonal, cultural, and professional skills through modules such as Introduction to Leadership, Business Project, and Introductory Internship. Learners gain the knowledge and practical skills required to support technology-driven organisations and progress towards higher-level study or careers in IT management and business technology. After the successful completion of the Programme, you will earn a UK 120 credit hours Certification awarded by GSS partners. The Program is delivered by one of GSS Partners.
courseDetails: Analyse fundamental concepts of information technology and evaluate their application within modern business and organisational environments. Apply programming, Python, database management, and ICT principles to develop and support technology-based business solutions. Evaluate management, organisational, leadership, and business administration principles in the context of IT-enabled organisations. Apply mathematical and economic concepts, including calculus, linear algebra, microeconomics, and macroeconomics, to support business and technology-related decision-making. Demonstrate effective leadership, communication, teamwork, problem-solving, and interpersonal skills within diverse organisational and professional environments. Plan, execute, and evaluate a business-related project and demonstrate practical workplace competence through an introductory internship. entry: Extended Level 5 Diploma in IT Management, learners must possess:
* Relevant/Local Board of Examination Result in your Country, which must include at least 5 'C' Grades in English and 4 other subjects.
* Mock Examination Results can also be accepted for initial Conditional Admission, pending the release of the Board of Examination Results. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
* Learner must be 18 years and older at the start of the Course.
Mature Learners (21 years and older) with work experience in supervisory, leadership or management roles. (This is assessed on a case-by-case basis).
accreditation: All GSS courses are accredited by the relevant partners and awarding bodies. Please refer to GSS accreditation in about us for more details. The Program is delivered by one of GSS Partners.
progression: Upon completing the Extended Level 5 Diploma in IT Management students become eligible to pursue advanced studies, including admission into a master's degree. This qualification opens doors to various programs, allowing students to specialize further in areas such as business administration, finance, or marketing.
workshops: This is a self-study programme with unlimited tutor support. You will never be more than a message or phone call away from our tutors. Workshops are conducted by live webinars for online students. Classroom workshops are available if there is a local branch in your country. Speak to our course advisors on this subject.
visa: There is no Visa requirement for this programme.
